ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Ley 10/2010, de 28 de abril, de prevención del blanqueo de capitales y de la financiación del terrorismo; Real Decreto 304/2014, de 5 de mayo (implementing regulation); Real Decreto-ley 7/2021, de 27 de abril (transposition of EU Directive 2018/843, recast UBO obligations); Real Decreto 646/2020, de 7 de julio (Single Beneficial Ownership Register operated by SEPBLAC); Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, Ley de Sociedades de Capital (arts. 9-10 on registered office and management center).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial registry or equivalent competent authority of the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization only if the issuing state is not a member of the HCCH Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport or national identity document of each director, shareholder, and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public or competent authority in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization for non-HCCH member jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Police criminal record certificate of each individual director and UBO
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National police, Ministry of Justice, or equivalent authority in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization for non-HCCH member jurisdictions

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney for the incorporation signatories, including express authorization to execute the deed of incorporation and open the corporate bank account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the country of origin, legalized through the Spanish consulate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Spanish consular legalization depending on the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference and source-of-funds confirmation for the initial capital contribution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent bank in the country of the contributing shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille; consular legalization for non-HCCH member jurisdictions

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory pre-incorporation screening of all directors, shareholders, and UBOs against the UN Security Council consolidated sanctions list, the EU CFSP consolidated financial sanctions list, the US OFAC SDN and consolidated sanctions lists (given USD payment rails and card processors), SEPBLAC alerts, and Spanish national terrorist asset-freezing lists. PEP status, family members, and close associates are declared under art. 14 Ley 10/2010 and art. 17 Real Decreto 304/2014, triggering enhanced due diligence where applicable. Adverse media and negative news screening are required. All screening results and CDD evidence must be retained for at least 10 years in accordance with Spanish AML retention obligations.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Central Commercial Registry (Registro Mercantil Central): online negative name certificate service via www.registradores.org and the CIRCE electronic incorporation portal (www.circe.es)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names may use any language written in Latin characters, but must be transliterated into Spanish orthography to ensure clear recognition. The designation 'Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada' or the abbreviation 'SL' is mandatory. Names must not be identical or misleadingly similar to an existing Spanish company, must be lawful and decent, and must not create confusion with official bodies, religious denominations, or regulated professions.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: The negative name certificate issued by the Registro Mercantil Central remains valid for 3 months and may be renewed once for a further 3-month period if the application is submitted before expiry and the name remains available. Upon rejection, the applicant may request clearance of up to 3 substitute names through the same online portal. If the refusal is based on statutory interpretation or registry error, the applicant may file an administrative appeal within 1 month before the Dirección General de Seguridad Jurídica y Fe Pública (formerly the DGRN) of the Ministry of Justice; judicial recourse is available before the Juzgado de lo Mercantil of Madrid. Sensitive tokens may be authorized by the competent ministerial authority only on documented grounds and prior approval.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A registered commercial domicile may be a contracted physical location operated by a professional corporate domiciliation provider; however, the registered office must coincide with the center of effective administration or principal place of activity under arts. 9-10 Ley de Sociedades de Capital. A bare post-office mailbox or purely virtual address lacking physical correspondence reception is not permissible and would expose the company to registry rectification action, loss of corporate domicile benefits, and tax residence re-characterization. For e-commerce auto parts retail, substance must be documented through warehouse or logistics contracts, management presence, Spanish accounting records, and the Spanish bank account.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-Medium: approximately 15% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection within the first 18 months after inscription, given the low-risk AML classification of ISIC 4791, absence of a statutory operating license, and the use of regulated payment rails such as Stripe and PayPal; inspections are more probable where inconsistencies appear between registered address, actual management center, and tax filings.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Negative company name clearance certificate (certificación negativa de denominación)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of the Central Commercial Registry for online issuance; approximately EUR 15 per requested name

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarial fees for the public deed of incorporation and articles of association (escritura de constitución)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public (Notaría) selected by the incorporating parties
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory notarial tariff under Royal Decree 1426/1989 scaled to stated capital and deed content; prevailing market range EUR 250-EUR 400

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: ITP-AJD tax on the first-copy notarial deed (documented legal acts)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Autonomous Community tax agency (e.g., Agencia Tributaria de la Comunidad de Madrid)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Applicable ITP-AJD rate of 0.5%-1.5% depending on autonomous community; Madrid standard 0.75% on corporate capital, approximately EUR 23-EUR 45 on EUR 3,000 capital
Registry statutory tariff under Real Decreto 1784/1996; approximately EUR 60-EUR 100 depending on number of registry entries

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Initial statutory share capital deposit for the SL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Spanish corporate bank account in the name of the SL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Ley de Sociedades de Capital art. 4 statutory minimum capital EUR 3,000; classified as contributed capital deposit rather than a non-refundable expense

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: NIE (Número de Identificación de Extranjeros) application fee for each non-resident director and shareholder
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria or Spanish consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: State fee 790-012, approximately EUR 10.92 per applicant; excludes administrative agent service fees

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostilled criminal record certificate of each individual UBO and director
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Police or Ministry of Justice authority of the country of residence plus issuing notary
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Foreign official fee plus notarial and Hague Apostille processing costs; required customer due diligence evidence under Ley 10/2010

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostilled corporate registry extract of any corporate shareholder
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Commercial registry of the shareholder's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Foreign registry issuance fee plus Hague Apostille; certificate of good standing limited to 90 days validity

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Gestoría and filing coordination fee for electronic incorporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for company formation management, NIE coordination, CIRCE submission, UBO register declaration, and post-registration compliance

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Commercial registered office service (domiciliación mercantil) and business correspondence handling
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Corporate domiciliation service provider in Madrid, Barcelona, or Valencia
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for first-quarter virtual commercial domicile with physical reception and document handling; requires substance-aligned corroboration under arts. 9-10 Ley de Sociedades de Capital

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Real Decreto Legislativo 1/2010, de 2 de julio, por el que se aprueba el Texto Refundido de la Ley de Sociedades de Capital (LSC), arts. 4, 12, 21-22, 58, 62, 124-126, 210-211; Real Decreto 1784/1996 (Reglamento del Registro Mercantil), arts. 175-196.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the registered office; Registro Mercantil Central (name certificate); Dirección General de los Registros y del Notariado (Ministry of Justice); Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (NIF).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura pública de constitución (public deed of incorporation) granted before a Spanish notary, followed by mandatory inscription in the Registro Mercantil Provincial; filing is submitted electronically by the notary via the LexNET/CIRCE system.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: EUR 3,000 minimum capital (LSC art. 4(1)) must be fully subscribed and fully paid up at incorporation. Cash contributions must be deposited in a Spanish bank account and evidenced by a bank deposit certificate (certificado de desembolso). No state escrow account is required, but the deposit must be blocked until the company is incorporated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: UNANIMOUS RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING MEMBER OF [COMPANY NAME] S.L. (the "Company"). FIRST: The founder subscribes the full EUR 3,000 corporate capital, represented by 3,000 registered shares of EUR 1 each, fully paid by bank deposit. SECOND: The registered office is set at [Address], Spain, within the Mercantile Registry of [City]. THIRD: [Name] is appointed sole administrator, with all powers granted by the Spanish Companies Act. FOURTH: The administrator is authorised to execute the incorporation deed, obtain the NIF, open bank accounts, and effect any ancillary registrations. FIFTH: The resolution takes effect immediately. Signed on [Date].

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Negative Name Certificate (Certificación Negativa de Denominación Social)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Central, Madrid; electronic filing via the CIRCE portal (Centro de Información y Red de Creación de Empresas).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit an application with up to five proposed corporate names to the Registro Mercantil Central via CIRCE or in person. The registry performs a search against registered names and issues a negative certificate if the name is available. Pay the prescribed fee electronically and retain the certificate for use in the notarial deed.
required_dossiers: Completed application form (Solicitud de certificación de denominación)
Domicile and identification document (DNI/NIE/passport) of the founding member or legal representative
Power of attorney if acting through a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is denied because of similarity to an existing name, file a new application with alternative names or submit a reconsideration appeal to the Dirección General de los Registros y del Notariado within one month.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtaining Provisional Tax Identification Number (NIF Provisional)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT), local or electronic office (Sede Electrónica).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Modelo 030 (censo de empresarios, profesionales y retenedores) to request a provisional NIF for the company to be incorporated. Attach the negative name certificate, identity documents, and proposed registered office. The provisional NIF is required for opening the bank deposit account and for signing the public deed.
required_dossiers: DNI or NIE of the founding partner(s)
Proof of proposed registered office (e.g., lease agreement or title deeds)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is refused or returned for corrections, amend and re-submit Modelo 030 electronically; if persistent issues arise, present original documents at the local AEAT office for manual validation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening the Deposit Account and Issuance of Capital Deposit Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish credit institution selected by the founders; deposit account in the name of the company in formation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary bank account in the exact name of the company under formation, using the provisional NIF. Deposit the minimum capital of EUR 3,000 (or higher if provided in the bylaws). Request a capital deposit certificate from the bank, stating the account holder, amount deposited, date, and the blocking condition until incorporation.
required_dossiers: Identification documents of the account signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses to issue the certificate due to name inconsistency, obtain a rectified name certificate or modify the account name; alternatively, use another authorized credit institution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Public Deed of Incorporation (Escritura Pública de Constitución)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Spanish Notary (Notaría) of the founders' choice; the notary coordinates electronic submission to the Registro Mercantil.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appear before the notary with all required documents. The notary reviews the legality of the proposed company, reads the deed and bylaws, and all founding members sign. The notary then orders the submission of the first copy of the deed and related documents to the Mercantile Registry for inscription.
required_dossiers: Bylaws (estatutos sociales) approved by the founders
Valid passport/DNI/NIE of all founding partners
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary detects defects or legal obstacles, the founders may amend the deed or bylaws and re-execute before the same notary. If the notary refuses to sign, seek alternative legal counsel and correct the cause; appeal to the DGRN where notarial refusal is unfounded.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Inscription (Inscripción en el Registro Mercantil Provincial)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Mercantil Provincial of the province where the registered office is located; electronic filing by the notary through the LexNET platform.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within five business days after execution, the notary submits the deed and supporting documents to the Mercantile Registry. The registrar examines the validity of the deed and the legal requirements. Upon approval, the company is formally incorporated and the registry issues the registration certificate (nota simple).
required_dossiers: First copy (primera copia) of the notarial deed
Certificate of no tax debt or other required declarations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registrar issues a negative qualification (calificación desfavorable), the company may cure the defects noted and resubmit, or file an administrative appeal (recurso gubernativo) with the Registrador and subsequently with the DGRN within two months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax, Social Security, and Local Licensing Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT); Tesorería General de la Seguridad Social (TGSS); Ayuntamiento (municipal body) for activity licensing/declaración responsable.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Apply for the definitive NIF using Modelo 036 within one month after inscription. File Modelo 600 (ITP/AJD) within 30 days of the deed to pay the Stamp Duty (Actos Jurídicos Documentados). Register the company with TGSS for social security obligations (NUSS, CCC), obtain employer registration, and if any physical premises are used, file the applicable municipal activity authorization (declaración responsable / licencia de apertura) depending on local ordinance.
required_dossiers: Certificado de inscripción en el Registro Mercantil (nota simple)
Municipal forms and technical plan for premises (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If AEAT delays the definitive NIF, provide the missing information via the electronic office within ten days; for municipal license denials, correct the technical report and resubmit under the local ordinance or file an appeal before the municipal council.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable - no industrial manufacturing license is required for online retail of automotive replacement parts; municipal Ayuntamiento is competent for any local premises authorization.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable - online auto parts retail does not require a state or regional industrial operating permit; a municipal activity communication may be required if a warehouse or office is established.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Consejería de Medio Ambiente of the relevant Autonomous Community; Ministry for the Ecological Transition (MITECO) for state-level matters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no full Environmental Impact Assessment required for online retail/storage of auto parts under Annex I/II of Ley 21/2013 de evaluación ambiental; only compliance with municipal waste ordinances is needed.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial wastewater or VOC emission thresholds apply. Management of used batteries, oil wastes, and packaging must comply with Ley 7/2022 de residuos, Real Decreto 710/2015 (batteries), and municipal waste collection rules; any discharge to municipal sewer must meet local limit values.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification for any office/warehouse in accordance with Real Decreto 513/2017 and Real Decreto 393/2007 (fire protection systems); occupational health and safety conformity under Real Decreto 486/1997 (workplace conditions); structural load clearance for storage shelving if a warehouse is operated; employment registration with TGSS and communication of workplace risk prevention plan.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Agencia Estatal de Administración Tributaria (AEAT) – Sede Electrónica at https://sede.agenciatributaria.gob.es
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Spanish Sociedad de Responsabilidad Limitada (ES_SL) must first be incorporated by public deed and registered in the Mercantile Registry. The company then obtains its definitive NIF (Número de Identificación Fiscal) from AEAT by filing Forms 036/037 and attaching the notarized deed and registry certificate. Non-resident foreign entities without a permanent establishment must obtain an NIF-NR through Form 030, appoint a tax representative in Spain, and present proof of incorporation, registered address, and identity of directors. VAT identification follows the same NIF procedure; the NIF serves as the VAT ID.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Spain does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. The ES_SL is automatically treated as a taxable person subject to Corporate Income Tax (Impuesto sobre Sociedades) at the general rate of 25% on worldwide income. Available statutory elections include: (i) election to be included in a consolidated tax group under Art. 56 LIS; (ii) election for the tax-neutral merger/split regime under Art. 77 LIS; (iii) election for the VAT group special regime under Art. 166 Ley 37/1992; and (iv) each newly created SL may apply the reduced 15% CIT rate for the first two taxable years with positive basis under Art. 29.1 LIS.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA – Impuesto sobre el Valor Añadido (Value Added Tax / VAT)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No economic turnover threshold is available for a Spanish resident SL; registration is mandatory before the first taxable supply, i.e., EUR 0. For non-established EU distance sellers, a EUR 10,000 threshold triggers Spanish VAT registration; for intra-Community acquisitions by resident taxable persons, the EUR 10,000 acquisition threshold may also apply. For third-country suppliers without a Spanish or EU establishment, VAT registration is required for any B2C sales or when the customer fails to self-assess reverse charge.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: B2G invoices must be issued electronically in Facturae format. Under Ley 18/2022 (Ley Crea y Crece), general B2B electronic invoicing is mandatory once implementing regulations are in force, with phased application scheduled for 2024-2025; no AEAT fiscal stamping applies. Taxpayers with annual turnover exceeding EUR 6 million, VAT groups, and certain customs-warehouse operators are subject to the Suministro Inmediato de Información (SII) regime, requiring near-real-time electronic transmission of invoice records through AEAT web-service APIs in XML schema. SMEs such as the typical ES_SL auto-parts e-commerce retailer are not generally subject to SII or continuous tax clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of tangible goods to non-EU destinations qualify for 0% IVA when the seller is a taxable person, the goods are physically dispatched or transported to a third country, and the goods leave EU territory within three months from dispatch unless a longer contractual period applies. The exporter must retain the customs export declaration and transport documents evidencing departure from the EU. For services, offshore B2B services are generally outside the scope of Spanish VAT under the general place-of-supply rule if the customer is established in a third country; ancillary services directly linked to the physical export of goods may be zero-rated. The zero-rating is not merely an exemption but a true 0% rate preserving input VAT recovery.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs export declaration (Documento Único Administrativo / DUA)
Bill of Lading, Air Waybill, or other contractual transport document evidencing physical exit from EU territory
Inward remittance certificate or bank transfer evidence of export proceeds
Commercial invoice with packing list and transport details
Certificate of origin or other supporting import documents from the destination country
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Export zero-rating is subject to strict documentary scrutiny. If the exporter cannot prove the physical exit of goods within the statutory period, AEAT will retroactively assess output VAT at the standard rate of 21%, plus late-payment interest and penalties under Ley General Tributaria Art. 191. The penalty scale ranges from 50% to 150% of the omitted tax depending on registration compliance. Where the false zero-rating exceeds EUR 120,000, criminal tax fraud under Organic Law 6/2023 may apply, with penalties including imprisonment and severe fines. A clawback also arises where export proceeds are not collected within the 180-day FX repatriation window, triggering a review of the export's commercial substance and potential reversal of the zero rating.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Spain maintains a fully liberalized foreign exchange regime under the euro. Capital account transactions face no quantitative restrictions or prior approval requirements. Current account transactions, including profit remittances from SL entities, are unrestricted for EU-resident companies. Non-resident ownership structures are permitted subject only to standard corporate registration and tax compliance filings.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or conversion ratio applies to export receipts. Companies may retain foreign currency in offshore accounts or convert freely to EUR. All export proceeds must nevertheless be declared for VAT (zero-rated) and corporate income tax purposes within one year of receipt, with supporting documentation retained for audit.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Corporate EMI viability is constrained in Spain. Platforms such as N26 Business or Revolut Business may issue cards but are subject to MiCA and national banking oversight; full cross-border FX settlement for SL entities typically requires correspondent banking relationships and is not supported by pure-play fintech EMI licenses.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical appearance of at least one director or authorized signatory is mandatory for corporate account opening and KYC interviews. Remote or virtual onboarding is not permitted for new SL companies without an existing banking relationship or specific regulatory exemption.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarized SL articles of association, Registro Mercantil extract, proof of registered office and directors, beneficial ownership certificate, and bank reference letters

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border capital injection from non-EU jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: FATF-compliant source-of-wealth documentation, trade contracts, valuation reports, and third-party independent verification confirming legitimate commercial purpose

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity or loan capital must be routed via SWIFT MT103 or SEPA Instant to the company’s Spanish IBAN. Purpose code must be ‘CAP’ or ‘EQTY’. All wires require matching beneficiary details, invoicing for equity contribution, and supporting board resolutions. Non-EUR funds are converted at spot rate by the receiving bank with full audit trail.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are cleared primarily through SWIFT MT103 using correspondent banks. Commercial Letters of Credit are available for larger transactions. Every disbursement requires purchase orders, supplier invoices, and AML documentation. Payments to non-EU suppliers must comply with transfer pricing and withholding tax rules.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Deposit of Annual Accounts (Cuentas Anuales) with Commercial Registry, including audit report if applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registro Mercantil (provincial Commercial Registry at the registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Fiscal year ending 31 December: shareholder approval required by 30 June; filing must occur within one month of approval, therefore by 31 July of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers registry closure (cierre registral) blocking any other corporate filings and monetary fines from EUR 1,200 to EUR 300,000 depending on balance-sheet volume and turnover; continued omission for successive years may lead to cancellation from the Registry

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 25 calendar days following the six months after the end of the tax period; for a calendar-year SL, by 25 July or next business day
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharges of 5%, 10%, 15% or 20% of the tax due depending on delay plus annualised late interest; penalties for non-filing range up to 150% of the tax liability, with minimum penalty EUR 300 for minor offences

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Calendar-year filers: between 1 and 30 January of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late presentation fines from EUR 200; proportional penalty may apply if the delay exceeds four months or where VAT declared is incorrect

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Legalisation of statutory books (Journal, Inventory and Annual Accounts book) with the Commercial Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within four months after the end of each financial year; for calendar-year companies, by 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to legalise books within the legal period results in a registry fine and the books lose evidentiary value in commercial matters; continued non-compliance may be treated as an administrative infraction

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An SL must appoint an auditor if, for two consecutive years, it meets at least two of the following: (a) total assets above EUR 4,000,000; (b) net turnover above EUR 8,000,000; (c) average headcount above 50. Companies below these thresholds may nevertheless opt for a voluntary audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Spanish GAAP (Plan General Contable, PGC) for individual annual accounts; IFRS as adopted by the EU is permitted for consolidated groups.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Spain does not impose a separate annual UBO confirmation filing. The SL must maintain a statutory 'Libro Registro de Titularidades Reales' and notify the Commercial Registry within one month of any change in beneficial ownership. Upon deposit of annual accounts, the registry may cross-check the updated beneficial ownership declaration.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro Registro de Socios)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas del Órgano de Administración)
Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owners (Libro Registro de Titularidades Reales)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 350–900 per annum (EUR 300–800) for a compliant registered office and agent service in Spain
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,700–4,500 (EUR 1,500–4,000) for a small-to-medium SL; nil if the company does not meet statutory audit thresholds and does not require voluntary audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 23% reduced rate on the first EUR 50,000 of taxable base for entities with prior-year net turnover below EUR 1 million (Art. 29.1 LIS); 15% rate for newly created entities in the first two tax periods with a positive taxable base (Art. 29.3 LIS as amended by Law 28/2022) provided the activity is economic and no shell indicators exist; R&D&I credits (25% base rate plus 8% technology innovation), employment-creation credits for R&D personnel (20%), and the 25% SME digitalization deduction (cap EUR 100,000) are available for qualifying e-commerce investments.
corporate_income_tax_regime.tax_loss_carryforward_regime: Indefinite carryforward of negative tax bases (Art. 26 LIS); annual offset limited to 70% of positive taxable base generally, 50% for entities with turnover EUR 20-60 million, 25% over EUR 60 million; small entities below EUR 1 million may additionally offset the minimum exemption floor only upon compliance with capitalization reserve rules.
